text_blocks.snippet: Mexico's external debt, which is debt owed to non-residents, was approximately $595.92 billion USD in 2023. This represents a slight increase (1.79%) compared to the $585.35 billion USD recorded in 2022, according to Macrotrends. While the total external debt is significant, it is important to note that it represents a decreasing percentage of Mexico's GDP, according to FocusEconomics. In 2023, external debt was about 33% of GDP, compared to 39.7% in the previous year.
